sources.source: Google's bcmdhd driver for Pixel (google-modules/wlan/bcmdhd, bcm4389, bcm4398, bcm4390): Kbuild, wl_cfg80211.h, wl_android.c: CUSTOM_ROAM_TRIGGER_SETTING=-75, CUSTOM_ROAM_DELTA_SETTING=10
Google's bcmdhd driver for Pixel (google-modules/wlan/bcmdhd, bcm4389, bcm4398, bcm4390): Kbuild, wl_cfg80211.h, wl_android.c: DEFAULT_ROAM_SCAN_PRD 10, DEFAULT_FULL_ROAM_PRD 0x78
Google's bcmdhd driver for Pixel (google-modules/wlan/bcmdhd, bcm4389, bcm4398, bcm4390): Kbuild, wl_cfg80211.h, wl_android.c: WBTEXT profiles a -70 -75 70 10 and b -60 -75 70 10
Google's bcmdhd driver for Pixel (google-modules/wlan/bcmdhd, bcm4389, bcm4398, bcm4390): Kbuild, wl_cfg80211.h, wl_android.c: WBTEXT_BTMDELTA=0
sources.note: the meaning of the BTM delta is inferred from its name
